goal: Win 1st or 2nd place, indie track: judged on creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works.

milestones.title: Skeleton and model plumbing
milestones.detail: Baseten (Muse Spark Open) and Meta Model API (Muse Spark) both answering.

milestones.title: On-device capture
milestones.detail: Screen change detection, voice-gated audio, Muse Voice Transcribe with speaker separation, remote-access and clipboard watchers.

milestones.title: Tier-1 analysts and the CaseFile
milestones.detail: Kill-chain signals from the screen and the call; injection-resistant prompts.

milestones.title: Tier-2 CaseJudge
milestones.detail: Hard stop authorised only by the judge, clamped in code.

milestones.title: Interventions
milestones.detail: Spoken nudge, full-screen warning, remote session ended, family PIN, 'close that box' resistance, allowlist.

milestones.title: Privacy, family alerts, dashboard
milestones.detail: On-device redaction, SAM 3.1 outlines, narrated incident page; texts in demo mode (Twilio trial limits).

milestones.title: Evaluation harness
milestones.detail: 12 scripted scenarios, Muse Image screen set, frame-level eval, Tier-1 ablation.

milestones.title: Stop scams earlier
milestones.detail: Median time to stop 46.5 s to 27.0 s; stops before the money request 25% to 50%.

milestones.title: Cloud Run deployment
milestones.detail: Public service in nixora-project; private bucket, Secret Manager, keys rotated.

milestones.title: Web arena: Can you scam Margaret?
milestones.detail: Visitor plays the scammer; Margaret (Muse Spark) answers aloud; real pipeline stops the scam live; scoreboard.

milestones.title: Act, don't just warn
milestones.detail: Tool-calling recovery agent: ends the remote session, freezes the card, drafts the fraud report, alerts the family.

milestones.title: Evaluation on data we did not write
milestones.detail: 340 third-party conversations (Apache-2.0). Baseline 61% stopped, 0% false alarms. New signals developed on the train split only; final test-split run in progress.

milestones.title: No claim without evidence
milestones.detail: Every judge reason must quote the record; code verifies it and refuses a hard stop without verified evidence. Train split: 316 claims checked, 0 unsupported.

milestones.title: Landing page and this dashboard
milestones.detail: Public product page for judges; live build dashboard.

milestones.title: Open-weight second opinion on Modal
milestones.detail: A Meta open-weight model on Modal confirms each hard stop (two-key rule), and is compared on the external benchmark.

milestones.title: Community Shield
milestones.detail: Scam numbers and fake brands from stopped scams protect every other family.

milestones.title: 3-minute video and submission
milestones.detail: Built around the arena, the evidence checks and the external results. Repo public before the deadline.
